scope: Sanitized native client evidence for the finding.created fixture preview and matching delivery receipts. The acceptance scope intentionally uses one visible theme per provider, as directed for this PR.

template_fields.title: Phát hiện mới

console_previews.capture_method: Each public PNG is a literal pixel rectangle from a private native browser screenshot. Original frames are not published; no retouching, generated pixels, or content replacement was used.
console_previews.root_theme_note: Some full-page captures had a dark root class while the captured preview panel was visibly light. The visible panel pixels, not the root class, define the theme recorded here.

review.visual_review: Independent native image QA opened all thirteen public PNGs and passed each image. Hashes and exact RGBA rectangles were rechecked against the private originals.
review.content_boundary: The console preview and each referenced provider receipt show the same selected fixture fields and visible link. Pixel inspection does not establish raw API or provider payload-byte parity; byte-level claims remain limited to the Gmail evidence that records MIME/preview comparisons.

limits: The record intentionally covers one visible theme per provider; it does not claim a theme, device, browser-engine, mobile, or accessibility matrix.
No fresh-send, elapsed-window soak, or production-capacity result is claimed here.
Some older stored-event previews fall outside the newest-twenty sample limit already recorded in notification-mixed-delivery-evidence.json; this record does not claim they were rerun.
No recipient address, OAuth credential, webhook URL, raw provider payload, full browser screenshot, or private DOM/HTML is published.
